title: VPC observability terraform module with upgrade health orchestration
creator: Ravi Patel
description:
Goal: Create a reusable Terraform module that provisions the observability stack for Private (VPC) deployments. Stack includes: Prometheus (server + alerting rules), Grafana (provisioned dashboards & datasources), OpenTelemetry Collector (receiver/processor/exporter pipeline), and a log-shipping component (Vector by default, configurable). The module must support zero-downtime upgrades, health checks for each component, canary rollouts, and clear upgrade/revert procedures.

Scope: module will be used by Private deployments (VPC) across AWS/Azure/GCP variants. It should avoid provider-specific resource assumptions where possible and expose provider-specific submodules for networking integrations (VPC endpoints, subnet mappings, security groups).
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module published under modules/observability with semantic versioning (v0.1.0) and README
Module can be instantiated in customer-like VPC and bring up Prometheus, Grafana, OTEL, and Vector with default configs
Automated health checks (k8s readiness/liveness or service-level probes) are created and exposed as outputs
Canary upgrade flow documented and scripted: upgrade 10% nodes, validate health, roll remainder or rollback
Integration tests (terraform apply/destroy smoke) run in CI and pass in two cloud providers
implementation_notes: Design: split into three submodules: monitoring (prometheus+alerting), dashboarding (grafana provisioning), collectors (otel + log-forwarder). Top-level module wires networking and IAM/KMS.
Upgrade strategy: implement 'canary_count' and 'max_unavailable' inputs; use null_resource triggers to sequence restarts when module version changes.
Health checks: expose Prometheus target health, OTEL collector /metrics and /healthz endpoints, Grafana provisioning status. Add a 'health_check_policy' map input to adjust thresholds.
Log shipper: default to Vector (lightweight, Rust) but allow fluentd or filebeat via 'log_shipper.provider' variable. Provide Helm chart options for k8s installs.
IAM/KMS: minimal privileges principle; KMS key id and role passed in. Ensure module supports SSE for remote write credentials.
Observability telemetry: add self-scrape targets for module (prometheus_remote_write) and preconfigured dashboards for collection metrics
